fullPassage: Take time to be bored. One time I heard a coworker say, "When I get busy, I get stupid." Ain't that the truth. Creative people need time to just sit around and do nothing. I get some of my best ideas when I'm bored, which is why I never take my shirts to the cleaners. I love ironing my shirts — it's so boring, I almost always get good ideas. If you're out of ideas, wash the dishes. Take a really long walk. Stare at a spot on the wall for as long as you can. As the artist Maira Kalman says, "Avoiding work is the way to focus my mind." Take time to mess around. Get lost. Wander. You never know where it's going to lead you.

❌ ④ iron: love 다음에는 동명사(-ing) 또는 to부정사가 와야 하므로 ironing이 올바름
det.tip: love + -ing/to부정사. 여기서 love ironing(동명사) 사용

❌ ④ to take: or로 연결된 병렬 구조에서 wash와 동일하게 동사원형 take가 와야 함

det.analysis: 본문: 'Avoiding work is the way to focus my mind' → Avoiding work is the way to (7단어, focus my mind 포함 시 9단어)
det.tip: Maira Kalman의 인용구: 일을 피하는 것이 집중의 방법

questions.passage: Take time to be bored. One time I heard a coworker say, "When I get busy, I get stupid." Ain't that the truth. Creative people need time to just sit around and do nothing. I get some of my best ideas when I'm bored, which is why I never take my shirts to the cleaners. I love ironing my shirts — it's so boring, I almost always get good ideas. If you're out of ideas, wash the dishes. Take a really long walk. Stare at a spot on the wall for as long as you can. As the artist Maira Kalman says, "Avoiding work is the way to focus my mind." Take time to mess around. Get lost. Wander. You never know where it's going to lead you.
questions.stem: 본문에서 '벽의 한 점을 응시하다'를 나타내는 영어 표현을 찾아 쓰시오. (5단어)

det.korean: 벽의 한 점을 응시하라.

det.tip: stare at = 응시하다. a spot on the wall = 벽의 한 점
